The usage feed is uncovered: this runtime raises none of UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStart or SubagentStop, so turn spend, in-flight width and finished-subagent spend are not fed back and no such event is registered.

Cache-prefix stability is not measurable here: this runtime reports a cached-read figure and no cache-write figure at all, so a ledger row carries real cached_input_tokens in cache_read and leaves cache_write unreported. `harness usage --by prefix` reports a Codex session as unknown rather than as a perfectly held prefix.

Return measurement is uncovered: this runtime writes a subagent to a rollout file of its own and records no parent-side tool use id on the child, so nothing joins a return to its call. A Codex subagent row records return_path, return_over_budget and return_measured as null, and `harness usage --by role` counts it in neither share.

Band routing is not decided on this runtime, so the decision log records no tier-agent-spawns row here: the spawn hook that reroutes an unnamed spawn to a band worker runs on Claude Code alone. Every other decision point writes on both runtimes, and the Bash ask is labelled from PostToolUse and SessionEnd, which both raise.
